title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
blurb: Encoded position by rotating query and key vectors, so attention scores depend only on relative offsets; now the default in most open LLMs.
intro: RoPE splits each query and key into 2-D pairs and rotates pair $i$ by angle $m\theta_i$ at position $m$. The dot product of a rotated query and key then depends on their positions only through $m - n$, giving relative position information with no extra parameters and no change to the attention kernel. The steps build RoPE in both memory layouts, at arbitrary positions, on a subset of dimensions, for ragged decode batches and for multimodal inputs; the capstone computes attention scores with the frequency rescalings used to extend context length.

steps.name: RoPE in both layouts
steps.note: Interleaved pairs versus split halves: same maths, different weights.
